text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Gold Ship—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? What in the world is that!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Look at that...! Inside that transparent 
box...! There are so many Umamusume 
trapped in there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Gold Ship points, I see a 
crane game filled with plushies modeled 
after various Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Who the hell did something so awful!? 
Dammit, I'm definitely gonna save you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship is calling out to the plushies 
inside the crane game...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. You're not the kind of 
softie who'd abandon a captured Umamusume, 
are you?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, go raise some serious hell out 
there! I'll be right here bearing witness 
to the rescue of the century!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
